remarks: LOCATION, LOCATION, LOCATION! Beautifully renovated, clean and bright 1 bedroom condo located on the 9th floor of building near vibrant Downtown Stamford.Hardwood floor throughout with an open- space floor plan. Generous sized bedroom with lots of closet space. Living room opens up to private balcony for great views of city. This building has everything - 24hr security, laundry, gym, a private in-ground pool and playground. Heat, hot water, gas, basic cable, and 1 parking space are INCLUDED! Close to popular downtown restaurants, theater, shops, mall, library, hospital, public transportation, schools & train station.
